title: Stocks Fall as Crude Oil Prices Soar and Alphabet Sparks AI Spending Concerns
excerpt: The S&P 500 Index ($SPX ) (SPY ) today is down -0.80%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ($DOWI ) (DIA ) is down -0.66%, and the Nasdaq 100 Index ($IUXX ) (QQ...
content_html:
Rich Asplund

Thu, July 23, 2026 at 7:05 AM PDT 6 min read

The S&P 500 Index ($SPX) (SPY) today is down -0.80%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average ($DOWI) (DIA) is down -0.66%, and the Nasdaq 100 Index ($IUXX) (QQQ) is down -1.20%.  September E-mini S&P futures (ESU26) are down -0.77%, and September E-mini Nasdaq futures (NQU26) are down -1.10%.

Stock indexes are trading lower today amid a double whammy of higher oil prices and a decline of more than -5% in Alphabet following its earnings report after Wednesday's close.  Alphabet raised its capital spending forecast for this year to $205 billion from $190 billion, spending more than double its 2025 capital spending and raising concern that the company will struggle to earn a sufficient return on its outsized AI investment.  Tesla is down more than -10% today after its earnings report late Wednesday also showed a surge in capital spending.

Meanwhile, WTI crude oil prices (CLU26) are up more than +5% today after the Iran-backed Houthis launched a missile and drone attack on two Saudi Arabian oil tankers in the Red Sea, expanding the oil disruptions beyond the Strait of Hormuz and threatening oil shipments in the Red Sea. The Houthis have vowed to blockade shipping linked to Saudi Arabia and warned shipowners against calling at the nation's ports.  The move threatens Saudi oil exports from Yanbu, a Red Sea hub that the Saudi's are using to ship crude since the war brought shipping through the Strait of Hormuz to a near halt.  President Trump said Tuesday that if there is a blockade in the Red Sea, the US "will take care of it."  Meanwhile, the US and Iran exchanged attacks for the 12th straight day, and the US maintained its blockade of Iranian oil shipments in the Persian Gulf. 

US weekly initial unemployment claims in the week ended July 18 fell by -22,000 to 187,000, which showed a stronger labor market than expectations for a slight increase to +210,000.  Continuing claims fell by -2,000 to 1.796 million, showing a stronger labor market than expectations for a rise to 1.809 million.

The Chicago Fed's June National Activity Index rose to -0.02, which was weaker than the expected rise to zero from May's revised -0.19.

标准普尔 500 指数 ($SPX) (SPY) 今天下跌 -0.80%，道琼斯工业平均指数 ($DOWI) (DIA) 下跌 -0.66%，纳斯达克 100 指数 ($IUXX) (QQQ) 下跌 -1.20%。 9 月 E-mini 标准普尔期货 (ESU26) 下跌-0.77%，9 月 E-mini 纳斯达克期货 (NQU26) 下跌-1.10%。

受油价上涨和周三收盘后公布财报后 Alphabet 股价下跌超过-5%的双重打击，股指今天走低。 Alphabet 将今年的资本支出预测从 1900 亿美元上调至 2050 亿美元，支出是 2025 年资本支出的两倍多，这引发了人们对该公司将难以从其庞大的人工智能投资中获得足够回报的担忧。 特斯拉周三晚间发布的财报也显示资本支出激增，导致其股价今天下跌超过-10%。

与此同时，伊朗支持的胡塞武装对红海两艘沙特阿拉伯油轮发动导弹和无人机袭击，将石油中断扩大到霍尔木兹海峡以外，并威胁到红海的石油运输，WTI 原油价格 (CLU26) 今天上涨超过 5%。 胡塞武装发誓要封锁与沙特阿拉伯有关的航运，并警告船东不要停靠该国港口。 此举威胁到沙特从延布的石油出口。延布是红海枢纽，自战争导致霍尔木兹海峡的航运几乎停止以来，沙特一直利用延布来运输原油。 特朗普总统周二表示，如果红海出现封锁，美国“将予以处理”。 与此同时，美国和伊朗连续12天相互攻击，美国维持对波斯湾伊朗石油运输的封锁。

截至 7 月 18 日当周，美国初请失业金人数下降 -22,000 人至 187,000 人，这表明劳动力市场强于预期，小幅增加至 +210,000 人。 持续申请失业救济人数下降-2,000至179.6万人，表明劳动力市场比预期的增长至180.9万人更为强劲。

芝加哥联储6月全国活动指数升至-0.02，弱于预期从5月份修正后的-0.19升至零。
